record_title: Balanced complete bipartite graphs uniquely maximize geodesic subpaths at diameter two
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is asserted only to the best of our knowledge. The closest prior results optimize induced open triangles alone or study geodesic subpaths without the diameter-two extremum; some related open-triangle full proofs were not inspected. No independent validation is asserted.
